claim: The Finals sensitivity constant K is 914400 (yaw 0.001 deg per count per sens unit). AimForge carried 138545.5 - a copy of the Overwatch 2 constant - which is 6.60x too small, so every Finals sens the tool printed before today was 6.6x too low.
method: User-supplied mouse-sensitivity.com calculation: THE FINALS hipfire, 1600 DPI, Mouse Look Sensitivity 8 -> 360 distance 28.125 in (71.4375 cm). K = DPI * cm360 * sens = 1600 * 71.4375 * 8. The same screenshot's Marvel Rivals row (1600 DPI, sens 0.46, 27.9503 in) reproduces AimForge's already-verified Rivals K to 5 decimals, which validates the method.
consequence: Finals family re-authored from 37.70 to 78.95 cm/360 (Stillframe 34.00 -> 71.20, keeping its 90px/mm identity), which is the speed the user actually played and rated good.
fieldVerdict: user played sens 8 at 57px/mm (= 78.95 cm/360 base, ~15.8 cm at the curve's 5x cap) and rated it good, 2026-09-10
